claim: CONFIRMED: Task 10 attributes ledger findings to a generated index record by plain string lens == name (name-level, not id/body_hash-level), and Task 12's variant-of clustering unions generated records on cosine>=VARIANT_MIN_COSINE OR identical name — so every member of an identical-name cluster (the natural product of re-generating the same fd-* agent with an edited spec/body) inherits byte-identical findings/adjudicated/hit_rate/smoothed_hit_rate.
